parameters.name: ids

get.description: Returns only names referenced by the caller own reviews, votes, bookmarks or server-validated draft associations. Unowned IDs reject the whole batch with 404; current content admission is not required.

disclosures.description: Only field names. Values are obtained from current authoritative, authorized facts. Defaults to no disclosure.

reference_ids.description: Only associations previously validated by the server under content admission. These IDs may be sent to myReviewsReferences.

reference_state.description: Historical proof coverage after the latest save. Previously validated associations remain usable after qualification expiry. unavailable means unvalidated associations could not be checked; draft text was saved.

DraftView.description: A private draft owned by the requester. Withdrawn drafts retain their original expiry. Saving a draft does not publish it.

OwnVote.description: Caller-owned vote receipt. Does not contain another author's title, body, rating, identity or aggregate counts.
